value.rationale: Crown graphs are a canonical vertex-transitive regular perturbation of a complete bipartite graph. Sharp weak-type constants of finite centered maximal operators are an established harmonic-analysis question. The exact matching-deletion gap 2/[n(n+1)] quantifies a nontrivial change in endpoint amplification not supplied by the generic degree/overlap estimate; the all-size classification is structurally motivated and reusable.
